behavior: On successful startup, connect emits one 'READY local=<bound> target=<target>' line to stdout before accepting, using the actual bound listener address
--quiet suppresses the decorative banner and 'Waiting...' text; the READY line still emits
tsnet init failure emits 'ERROR reason=<token> detail="..."' to stderr with token in {bad_authkey, control_plane_unreachable, unknown} matching the classified cause
An unrecognized init failure still emits ERROR reason=unknown (never silent)
detail="..." is a single parseable line with embedded quotes and newlines escaped
No regression: existing Run and connect flag behavior unchanged without --quiet
